notes.title: Game update!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello again! Voice acting from AniLibria is now in the game!

A short while after the release, we're ready to present you the Russian voice-over for the game, which you will be able to listen to simultaneously while reading to enhance your experience.

We're also happy to announce that this update coincided with the Steam fall sale, so right now you can buy our game with a 15% discount.

We also added a small DLC, it's very short, but this does not make it less atmospheric, be sure to pay attention to it.[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273570
